🇲🇽🏗️ <u>Tlaxcala: 7,000 Public Works in Five Years, Zero Debt</u>

Tlaxcala Governor Lorena Cuéllar marked five years of the Fourth Transformation in the state with more than 7,000 public works across all 60 municipalities, on a limited budget and without contracting public debt. The list: a new General Hospital replacing one that was 77 years old, 15 new medical facilities, 30 new secondary schools, 10 universities, and over 58,000 housing, basic-services and social-support actions. A Regional Specialty Hospital is next.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>Palestine's Ambassador Leads Mexico City March for Gaza</u>

Palestinian Ambassador to Mexico Nadya Rasheed marched from Paseo de la Reforma to the Alameda Central alongside a family exiled from Gaza, anti-Zionist Jewish organizations and some thousand demonstrators. Organizers said 59 other cities joined the Global Day of Action. The demands: an immediate ceasefire in Gaza, and for the Mexican government to break relations with Israel. In San Cristóbal de Las Casas, Chiapas, actress Ofelia Medina and singer Rubén Albarrán joined the call to stop the genocide.
banner: CDMX MARCHES FOR GAZA WITH 59 CITIES

🚨🇲🇽 <u>No T-MEC Deal Before the US Midterms, Johns Hopkins Economist Warns</u>

Mexico should not expect a trade deal with Washington before November. A Johns Hopkins economist told La Jornada: "There is no possibility of an agreement before the November elections. Definitely not." The easy chapters are closed. What's left is the hard part: regional content in strategic sectors and US proposals to restrict Chinese investment in Mexico. Even with a signed deal, the White House can still impose unilateral tariffs. "The baseline of tariffs has already changed." Canada already got last-minute conditions.
banner: T-MEC: NO DEAL BEFORE US MIDTERMS

🇲🇽📊 <u>Mexico Borrows at Home: 2027 Debt Ceilings 26.9% Below 2024</u>

Hacienda will keep Mexico's debt "predominantly in national currency and long-term" to cut exposure to external volatility, Undersecretary María del Carmen Bonilla told the Chamber of Deputies, per El Economista. For 2027 the government is requesting an internal ceiling of 1.7 trillion pesos and only $13.5 billion abroad. Those ceilings are 26.9% lower in real terms than in 2024, and public-sector borrowing requirements fall from 4.1% to 3.9% of GDP. Health spending rises 11% and education 8%.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Damián Merlo: The Miami Lobbyist Between Cerimedo and Ambassador Johnson</u>

El Soberano traces the man who connects Fernando Cerimedo's disinformation network to Ronald Johnson, the US ambassador to Mexico. Damián Merlo runs Miami's Latin America Advisory Group. Its FARA filings show it advised the presidency of El Salvador, where Johnson was US ambassador from 2019 to 2021. A 2023 memo Merlo signed to Cerimedo, CEO of Numen, sealed their joint work on Milei's campaign. Before that, from 2002 to 2007, Merlo ran the International Republican Institute's programs for Mexico, Cuba and Brazil.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>Trump's Tariffs Were Supposed to Shrink Mexico's Share. It Grew to 17%</u>

US imports from Mexico hit $60.637 billion in August, the fourth straight monthly record, according to US Census data analyzed by Contralínea. Mexico now accounts for about 17% of everything the United States imports, up from 15% in 2025. Canada is at 11% and China at 7%. The US trade deficit with Mexico, the one Trump set out to correct, has deepened. "The economic interdependence of both countries obliges us to be good neighbors, without interference or subordination."

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>372 Delegates From 43 Countries, Meeting in Mexico: Stop the Siege of Cuba</u>

The PT's 30th International Seminar, "Political Parties and Society," closed in Mexico with a unanimous demand to end the escalating aggression against Cuba, including the economic and energy blockade. The 372 delegates from 43 countries backed Cuba's right to build a sovereign, independent, socialist nation and called Trump's policy a genocide against the Cuban people. They also demanded the immediate release of Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores. The final session ran nearly 12 hours.
banner: 43 COUNTRIES IN MEXICO: END CUBA SIEGE

🇲🇽🌎 <u>Petro: Mexico Is Latin America's Last Progressive Stronghold</u>

Speaking in Mexico City, former Colombian president Gustavo Petro said Mexico is practically the only country in Latin America where progressivism is still standing, and that if elections were held today, Morena's candidate would win "almost with certainty." His diagnosis: the first progressive wave, from Chávez on, rested on oil, coal and gas. The second won bigger social gains but is being stripped away "through lies, fear and algorithm." He proposed a regional digital-activism network against bot-driven election manipulation, starting with Brazil's runoff.

🇲🇽🏠 <u>Los Cabos: 13,000 Homes at 627,000 Pesos Where Social Housing Costs Up to 2.5 Million</u>

In Los Cabos, an "affordable" home runs 1.5 to 2.5 million pesos, out of reach for the hotel and construction workers who keep the resort running. Infonavit's San Pablo project, part of Sheinbaum's Vivienda para el Bienestar, plans 13,000 homes of at least 60 m² at an average of 627,000 pesos: less than half the market price, as low as a quarter. Investment: 9.5 billion pesos, 120 hectares bought from the San José del Cabo ejido, a community for about 75,000 people. Nationally the program has 667,000 homes contracted toward a 1.8 million goal, El Economista reports.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>After 12 Dead at Mazatlán's El Castillo Prison, the Federal Government Will Build a New One</u>

Security chief Omar García Harfuch announced a new federally funded penitentiary in Sinaloa, ordered by President Sheinbaum, after deadly violence inside the El Castillo prison in Mazatlán. "The Government of Mexico will build, with federal resources, a new penitentiary center in Sinaloa, modern, safe and with the necessary infrastructure to strengthen penitentiary control," he said. Meanwhile, El Castillo has been reinforced with National Guard and federal prison staff. Governor Graciela Domínguez is providing the land.
banner: SINALOA: NEW FEDERAL PRISON AFTER 12 DEAD
